home.title: Imikino n'imyidagaduro ku babana n'uburwayi bwo kwibagirwa na Alzheimer | Golden Moments
home.description: Imikino y'amafoto ituje kandi y'ubuntu yo gukinira kuri interineti n'ibitekerezo by'imyidagaduro ku babana n'uburwayi bwo kwibagirwa cyangwa Alzheimer n'ababitaho. Nta kwiyandikisha, nta gihe kibara cyangwa amanota.
home.eyebrow: Ubuntu · Nta matangazo · Nta kwiyandikisha · Nta gihe kibara cyangwa amanota
home.h1: Imikino ituje n'imyidagaduro y'ababana n'uburwayi bwo kwibagirwa
home.lede: Imikino yoroheje y'amafoto, amafoto amenyerewe, n'imyidagaduro yo gusangira mufatanyije—buri wese ku muvuduko umubereye.
facts: Bikora kuri terefoni, tabuleti na mudasobwa
Hagarara igihe cyose ubishakiye; nta gutsindwa bibamo
home.heroApp: Hari na apurikasiyo y'ubuntu ya iPhone, iPad na Android, ikoresha amafoto y'umuryango wawe bwite
home.gamesEyebrow: Kinira muri mushakisha yawe ya interineti
home.gamesLede: Buri mukino uratuje, ukwiranye n'abantu bakuru kandi utangira vuba. Hitamo umwe, mwicarane iruhande, maze mugende mukora kuri ecran musimburana.

steps.title: Hitamo ikintu kimenyerewe
steps.text: Amafoto y'ibikombe by'icyayi, ubusitani, amatungo n'amato yo mu mazi. Nta gusoma cyangwa amategeko yo kubanza kwiga.

steps.title: Mwicarane iruhande
steps.text: Mureke akore kuri ecran. Muganire ku mafoto. Iyo amafoto adahuje, haguma gutegerezwa gusa ikindi gikorwa cyo gukoraho.

steps.title: Muhagarike mu gihe bikiri byiza
steps.text: Umukino umwe ni umwidagaduro wuzuye. Ahanditse “Bihagije aka kanya” hahora kuri ecran.

home.stageLede: Umuziki, imirimo ya buri munsi, kwibuka ibyahise, n'ibihe bituje byo kumva no gukoraho, bihuje n'ibimworoheye muri iki gihe.

stages.title: Icyiciro cyo gutangira
stages.text: Komeza gukora ibyo bakunda, uhindureho bike gusa: ibyo bishimira gukora, gutembera, imikino y'amagambo no gupangira ibintu hamwe.
stages.label: Ibitekerezo byo mu cyiciro cyo gutangira

stages.title: Icyiciro cyo hagati
stages.text: Imirimo yoroheje kandi imenyerewe igabanyijemo intambwe: gufunika, gutondeka ibintu, umuziki, imikino y'amafoto no gutembera ahitaruye gato.
stages.label: Ibitekerezo byo mu cyiciro cyo hagati

stages.title: Icyiciro cya nyuma
stages.text: Ihumure no kwiyumvanamo binyuze mu gukorana ku mubiri, amajwi n'amashusho: kwitaho ibiganza, indirimbo zikunzwe, amafoto no kuba hamwe.
stages.label: Ibitekerezo byo mu cyiciro cya nyuma

home.specificHtml: Hari ikintu cyihariye ushaka? Gerageza imyidagaduro n'imikino y'ababana na Alzheimer, imikino ituje yo kwibuka, ibibazo n'ibisubizo byoroheje cyangwa puzzle.
home.approachTitle: Umwidagaduro wo gusangira, atari ikizamini cyo kwibuka
home.approachLede: Imikino myinshi “y'ubwonko” yubakiye ku muvuduko, amanota no gutsinda kenshi wikurikiranya. Ku muntu ubana n'uburwayi bwo kwibagirwa, ibyo bishobora kumera nk'ikizamini. Twebwe twubatse ibitandukanye n'ibyo.

principles.title: Nta gutsindwa bibamo
principles.text: Nta saha, amanota, umubare w'amahirwe cyangwa gutsindwa. Ifoto idahuye iba ari ukuruhuka gato, si ikosa.

principles.title: Amafoto aguma kugaragara
principles.text: Gusobanukirwa ibigaragara aho gusubiza mu mutwe. Guhuza bitangira amafoto agaragara hejuru, bityo nta kintu cyo gufata mu mutwe kiba gikenewe.

principles.title: Bikwiriye abantu bakuru kandi byiyubashye
principles.text: Amagambo yuje urugwiro, asobanutse neza n'amafoto yo mu buzima busanzwe. Nta bishushanyo by'abana cyangwa imvugo nk'igenewe abana bibamo.

principles.title: Ibyo ukora birinzwe kuva ku ntangiriro
principles.text: Nta makonti cyangwa amatangazo. Amafoto yawe ntiyigera ava ku gikoresho cyawe.

guides.text: Gushakisha amagambo mu nyandiko nini, impapuro zo gusiga amabara, bingo n'amakarita yo kuganira.

home.researchTitle: Ubuzima bw'ubwonko: icyo ubushakashatsi bubivugaho mu by'ukuri
home.researchText: Ese uburwayi bwo kwibagirwa bushobora gukumirwa? Ese imikino y'ubwonko igira icyo ifasha? Bite se ku kwiyiriza, imirire, ibitotsi no kumva? Ibisubizo bisobanutse kandi bishingiye ku bimenyetso, harimo n'aho ibimenyetso bikiri bike.
home.appTitle: Golden Moments kuri iPhone, iPad na Android
home.appText: Apurikasiyo y'ubuntu ikora na interineti idahari, kandi ishobora gukoresha amafoto y'umuryango wihitiyemo, abikwa nk'amakopi ku gikoresho cyawe. Ihuriro rituje nk'iryasanzwe: amakara ane manini, nta gihe kibara, nta manota.

faq.q: Ni iyihe mikino myiza ku bantu babana n'uburwayi bwo kwibagirwa?
faq.a: Imikino myiza iroroshye, iramenyerewe kandi nta gahato iteza: amashusho manini yo guhuza, gutoranya no gushyira ku murongo, uduce tworoshye tw'amashusho duteranywa, kuzuza imvugo zizwi, gusiga amabara, bingo y'amashusho n'amakarita yo kuganira. Igihitamo cyiza ni igishimisha uwo muntu uyu munsi. Irinde kubara igihe, amanota n'ikintu cyose gisa n'ikizamini.

faq.q: Ese iyi mikino y'abafite indwara yo kwibagirwa ni ubuntu?
faq.a: Yego. Buri mukino n'ibikoresho byo gucapa biri kuri Golden Moments ni ubuntu, nta konti, nta kwiyandikisha cyangwa kumanura kuri interineti. Imikino ikinirwa muri mushakisha y'urubuga kuri telefone, tabuleti cyangwa mudasobwa.

faq.q: Ese imikino y'ubwonko irinda indwara yo kwibagirwa?
faq.a: Nta mukino wigeze ugaragaza ko urinda indwara yo kwibagirwa, kandi Golden Moments ntivuga ko ivura cyangwa irinda ikintu icyo ari cyo cyose. Imikino yacu igenewe kwidagadura no kumarana igihe hamwe. Igice cyacu cy'ubuzima bw'ubwonko gisobanura icyo ubushakashatsi bwerekana n'icyo buterekana.

faq.q: Ese iyi mikino ibereye umuntu ufite indwara ya Alzheimer?
faq.a: Yego. Indwara ya Alzheimer niyo itera cyane indwara yo kwibagirwa, kandi imikino yakorewe ibyo: amashusho manini aguma kugaragara, amahitamo make, kandi nta kintu cyo gufata mu mutwe cyangwa kwibeshaho. Guhuza, gutoranya no kuzuza imvugo zimenyerewe byishingikiriza ku bumenyi bwa kera aho kuba ibintu bishya byo kwiga.

faq.q: Ese umuntu uri mu cyiciro cyisumbuye cy'indwara yo kwibagirwa ashobora gukora ibi bikorwa?
faq.a: Akenshi birashoboka, igihe hari umuntu bari kumwe. Tangirira kuri Shaka ibisa bifite amashusho abiri, Guhuza amashusho asa bifite uduce tune, urupapuro rwo gusiga amabara cyangwa akanya gato ko guhumeka mu ituze. Bikore mu gihe gito, ugendere ku byo bifuza kandi uhagarike igihe bumva bihagije.

Uru rubuga ntirugira amakonti kandi nta kwamamaza kurangwaho. Dukoresha Google Analytics kugira ngo dusobanukirwe amapaji asurwa. Amafoto uhitamo muri Photo pairs agaragara gusa muri mushakisha yawe kandi ntajya ku mbuga z'ububiko na rimwe.

Golden Moments ni itsinda rito rikora ibikorwa bituje by'amashusho bigenewe abantu bakuru, bikozwe ku bw'imiryango n'abitaho ababo, biboneka ku rubuga no kuri porogaramu y'ubuntu. Ntituri abaganga, kandi nta biri hano bigize inama z'ubuvuzi.

playCta.title: Witeguye umukino utuje?
playCta.text: Amashusho manini, nta kubara igihe, nta manota kandi nta kwiyandikisha bisabwa. Kinire hamwe muri mushakisha yawe.

appCta.title: Gendana iyi mikino aho uri hose
appCta.text: Porogaramu y'ubuntu ya Golden Moments ya iPhone, iPad na Android: amashusho manini, imikino irimo amafoto y'umuryango wawe, n'amatsinda y'amashusho akora nta Wi‑Fi. Nta konti, nta matangazo, nta kubara igihe cyangwa amanota.

activities.label: Ibikorwa
activities.title: Ibikorwa by'abantu bafite indwara yo kwibagirwa
activities.seo: Ibikorwa by'abantu bafite indwara yo kwibagirwa: Ibitekerezo ukurikije ibyiciro
activities.description: Ibitekerezo by'ibikorwa by'abantu babana n'indwara yo kwibagirwa muri buri cyiciro: umuziki, kwibuka ibya kera, imirimo ya buri munsi, ibikorwa bikangura ingingo, ubukorikori, ibyo hanze n'ibikoresho byo gucapa by'ubuntu.
activities.lede: Igikorwa gifite agaciro ni ikintu cyose kizana ihumure, intego cyangwa umwanya wo gusabana. Tangirira ku cyo umuntu yahoraga akunda, maze ugihuze n'uko ameze uyu munsi.

caregiving.label: Kwita ku muntu
caregiving.title: Inyoborabumenyi zo kwita ku muntu
caregiving.seo: Inyoborabumenyi zo kwita ku bafite indwara yo kwibagirwa: Ubufasha ngirakamaro bwa buri munsi
caregiving.description: Inyoborabumenyi zifatika kandi zigaragaza impuhwe ku bita ku bafite indwara yo kwibagirwa: gukinira hamwe, itumanaho, kwanga gukora ibintu, guhangayika ku mugoroba, tabuleti, guhitamo porogaramu no kwiyitaho.
caregiving.lede: Ubufasha bworoshye kandi bufatika mu bihe bya buri munsi byo kwita ku muntu ubana n'indwara yo kwibagirwa, harimo no kwiyitaho ubwawe.

brain-health.label: Ubuzima bw'ubwonko
brain-health.title: Ubuzima bw'ubwonko: Icyo ubushakashatsi bubivugaho
brain-health.seo: Ubuzima bw'ubwonko n'ibyago byo kurwara indwara yo kwibagirwa: Icyo ubushakashatsi bubivugaho
brain-health.description: Ese indwara yo kwibagirwa ishobora kwirindwa? Inyoborabumenyi z'ukuri kandi zishingiye ku bimenyetso zivuga ku bintu byongera ibyago byo kurwara indwara yo kwibagirwa, imikino y'ubwonko, kwiyiriza ubusa, imirire, imyitozo ngororamubiri, ibitotsi, ukumva n'ibimenyetso by'imbuzi.
brain-health.lede: Icyo ubushakashatsi bunini bwerekana by'ukuri ku bijyanye no kugabanya ibyago by'indwara yo kwibagirwa, bisobanuye mu buryo bworoshye, harimo n'aho ibimenyetso bidahagije cyangwa bivuguruzanya. Ni amakuru muri rusange, si inama z'ubuvuzi.

guide.sourcesNote: Dushyiraho imiyoboro igana ku miryango n'ubushakashatsi iyi paji yifashishije. Buri kimwe cyasuzumwe igihe paji yavugururwaga.

healthNotice.title: Amakuru muri rusange, si inama z'ubuvuzi
healthNotice.textHtml: Iyi paji ikubiyemo incamake y'ubushakashatsi bwashyizwe ahagaragara igenewe imiryango. Ntiyashobora kukubwira ibikwiriye umuntu runaka by'umwihariko. Vugana na muganga mbere yo guhindura imirire, imyitozo ngororamubiri, ibitotsi, imiti cyangwa inyongeramirire. Ku rujijo rutunguranye cyangwa izindi mpinduka zitunguranye, shaka ubufasha bw'ubuvuzi bwihuse. Soma itangazo ryacu ry'amakuru y'ubuzima.

about.title: Igikorwa cyo gusangira, si ikizamini cyo kwibuka
about.description: Impamvu imikino ya Golden Moments itagira kubara igihe, amanota cyangwa gukurikiranya gutsinda, impamvu amashusho aguma kugaragara, n'icyo tuvuga n'icyo tutavuga ku ndwara yo kwibagirwa.
about.lede: Golden Moments ikora ibikorwa bituje by'amashusho bigenewe abantu bakuru, ibyo uwita ku muntu n'umuntu ubana n'indwara yo kwibagirwa bashobora kwishimira bari kumwe.
about.bodyHtml:
Icyo twemera

Intego y'umukino cyangwa igikorwa ni uwo mwanya ubwawo: ikiganiro, kumwenyura, ibyishimo byo guhuza amafoto abiri, cyangwa kwicarana gusa mwegeranye. Si ukugena ubushobozi bw'umuntu, kumuhata cyangwa kugaragaza ikintu icyo ari cyo cyose.

Porogaramu nyinshi zivuga ko zitoza ubwonko ziba zubatse ku muvuduko, amanota, urukurikirane n'intera. Ku muntu ubana n'indwara yo kwibagirwa, ibyo bishobora kumera nk'ikizamini adashobora gutsinda. Twe twateguye ibitandukanye n'ibyo, kandi twubahiriza aya mabwiriza:

  • Nta gutsindwa kubamo. Nta saha, nta manota, nta kubara ibikorwa wakoze, nta buzima bubarwa, nta nkurikirane, nta birori by'ibipapuro bimanuka cyangwa kubara igihe kigabanuka, ku rukuta urwo ari rwo rwose.
  • Kumenya icyo ubona aho kwibuka mu mutwe. Amafoto akomeza kugaragara igihe cyose. Ubutumwa buteganyijwe buteza imbere ibiganiro kandi ntibwigera bubaza amazina cyangwa ibyabaye kera mu buryo bwo gupima umuntu.
  • Binini, bisobanutse kandi bidahindagurika. Amagambo n'amafoto binini, ibiranga bitandukanye neza mu mabara, n'uburyo bwo gukoresha buguma ahantu hamwe.
  • Icyubahiro gikwiriye umuntu mukuru. Amafoto y'ibintu bifatika byo mu buzima busanzwe n'amagambo asanzwe kandi yuje urugwiro. Nta bishushanyo by'abana, nta gusingiza birenze cyangwa ibihembo bya emoji.
  • Uburyo bworoshye bwo guhagarika igihe ushakiye. Ahagira hati “Bihagije ubu” haba hagaragara igihe cyose. Guhagarika umukino utarangiye na byo ni byiza cyane.
  • Kugira ibanga kuva ku ntangiriro. Nta konti isabwa cyangwa amatangazo yamamaza. Amafoto uhisemo aguma mu gikoresho cyawe bwite.

Ibyo tutavuga cyangwa ngo twizeze

Imikino yacu igenewe gushimisha no kwegerana. Ntishobora gusuzuma, gupima, kuvura, gukumira cyangwa kugabanya umuvuduko w'indwara yo kwibagirwa cyangwa Alzheimer, kandi nta muntu ukwiriye kuyihitamo abishingiye kuri ibyo. Iyo twanditse ku bushakashatsi ku mpapuro zacu z'ubuzima bw'ubwonko, tuvuga mu buryo bweruye aho ibimenyetso biba bidahagije, kandi ntitwigera tubihuza n'imikino yacu bwite.

Abo turi bo

Golden Moments ni itsinda rito ryigenga. Ntituri abaganga. Inyandiko zacu n'ubuyobozi butangwa bishingira ku nyandiko zatangajwe n'imiryango nka National Institute on Aging na Alzheimer’s Association, kandi buri nyandiko igaragaza aho amakuru yakomotse. Soma uburyo twandikamo kandi tugasuzuma impapuro zacu.

Tubwire icyagufasha

Twakwishimira cyane kumva ibigenda neza n'ibitagenda neza, by'umwihariko biturutse ku bantu babana n'indwara yo kwibagirwa, abagize umuryango babitaho n'abakozi bategura imyidagaduro. Twandikire kuri {email}.

editorial.title: Uburyo Twandikamo Kandi Tugasuzuma Impapuro Zacu
editorial.description: Uburyo Golden Moments ikoramo ubushakashatsi, yandika, itunganya amasoko y'amakuru, ikanavugurura impapuro zayo z'imyidagaduro yo kwibagirwa n'ubuzima bw'ubwonko, hamwe n'ibyo tutazigera na rimwe dutangaza.
editorial.bodyHtml:
Aho dukura amakuru

Inyandiko zacu zishingira ku mabwiriza n'inama rusange bitangwa n'imiryango nka National Institute on Aging, CDC, Alzheimer’s Association, Alzheimer’s Foundation of America, Family Caregiver Alliance na NHS, hamwe n'ubushakashatsi bwasuzumwe n'abahanga nka Cochrane reviews n'igeragezwa ryagutse ry'ubuvuzi. Buri nyandiko igaragaza aho amakuru yayifashishijwemo yakomotse. Dusoma neza buri soko y'amakuru mbere yo kuyisobanura, kandi dutangaza gusa ibyo ivuga nyabyo.

Uburyo twandikamo

  • Ibikorwa bifatika mbere na mbere: ibyo gukora uyu munsi, mu rurimi rworoshye kandi rusobanutse.
  • Kuvugisha ukuri ku bimenyetso: tuvuga ko “bifitanye isano na”, “bishobora” no kuba “ibimenyetso bivuguruzanya” igihe ari byo biriho koko.
  • Kubaha: twandika ku bantu babana n'indwara yo kwibagirwa nk'abantu bakuru, kandi ntitwigera dukoresha amagambo yo kubapima cyangwa kubakoza isoni.
  • Nta byahimbwe: nta mibare, amagambo y'abantu, inzobere, ubushakashatsi, isuzuma cyangwa ubuhamya byahimbwe.

Abasuzuma impapuro zacu

Impapuro zandikwa kandi zigasuzumwa n'itsinda rya Golden Moments, rifashijwe n'ibikoresho by'ubwenge bw'ubukorano mu gukora ubushakashatsi no gutegura inyandiko z'ibanze. Buri rupapuro rusuzumwa n'itsinda hakurikijwe amasoko y'amakuru yarwo. Impapuro zacu ntizigeze zisuzumwa na muganga cyangwa impuguke mu buvuzi, kandi ntituvuga ko ari byo. Zitanga amakuru rusange gusa, si inama z'ubuvuzi.

Ibyo tutazigera dutangaza

  • Ibyemezo bivuga ko umukino, ibyokurya, inyongeramirire, kwiyiriza ubusa cyangwa gahunda runaka bikumira, bivura, bidindiza cyangwa bikiza indwara yo kwibagirwa.
  • Ibizamini, ibibazo cyangwa amanota agaragaza ko umuntu afite, cyangwa adafite, indwara yo kwibagirwa.
  • Inama zo gutangira, guhagarika cyangwa guhindura umuti uwo ari wo wose.
  • Amatangazo yamamaza cyangwa inyandiko zishyuriwe zihishe mu isura y'ubuyobozi n'inama.

Kuvugurura no gukosora

Buri rupapuro rugaragaza itariki ruherukira kuvugururwaho. Niba ubonye ikosa cyangwa isoko y'amakuru itakijyanye n'igihe, tubashimiye kohereza ubutumwa kuri {email} kandi tuzabisuzuma vuba bishoboka.

faq.title: Ibibazo n'Ibisubizo
faq.seoTitle: Imikino n'Imyidagaduro ku Babana n'Indwara yo Kwibagirwa: Ibibazo n'Ibisubizo
faq.description: Ibisubizo by'ibibazo bikunze kubazwa ku mikino n'imyidagaduro y'ababana n'indwara yo kwibagirwa: imikino yo kugerageza, igihe cyo gukina, ibitekerezo byo mu byiciro bikurikiraho, ubuzima bw'ubwonko no kubika ibanga.
faq.lede: Ibisubizo bigufi kandi bisobanutse by'ibibazo abita ku bandi bakunze kubaza cyane.

items.q: Ni iyihe mikino myiza ku muntu ubana n'indwara yo kwibagirwa?
items.a: Imikino myiza ni isanzwe izwi, yoroshye kandi itarimo igitutu, kandi umukino ukwiriye ni uwushimisha umuntu kuri uwo munsi. Guhuza amafoto agaragara neza, gutoranya no gushyira mu matsinda, ibikwasi byoroshye by'amafoto, kuzuza imvugo cyangwa imigani isanzwe izwi, gusiga amabara na bingo y'amashusho, byose bigirira akamaro abantu benshi. Irinde ibipima igihe, amanota n'ikintu cyose cyakumvikana nk'ikizamini.

items.q: Ese koko iyi mikino itangirwa ubuntu?
items.a: Yego. Imikino yose n'ibishushanyo byo gucapa ni ubuntu, nta konti, kwiyandikisha, gukuramo cyangwa kwamamaza.

items.q: Kuki nta manota, inzego cyangwa ibihe?
items.a: Umuvuduko n'amanota bihindura igikorwa cyiza mo ikizamini, bishobora kuzana isoni cyangwa umujinya. Dushyira imbere kwishimana no kumarana igihe, ku buryo nta kintu cyo gutsindwa kirimo, kandi mushobora guhagarara igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.

Telefoni, tabuleti cyangwa mudasobwa yose ifite urubuga rugezweho. Tabuleti iri ku kirenge ku meza akenshi ni yo ituma abantu babiri bakina bicaranye neza. Mudasobwa ihuzwa na televiziyo ikora neza ku matsinda.

items.q: Dushobora gukina dukoresheje amafoto yacu y'umuryango?
items.a: Yego. Amafoto ahuje ahindura amafoto 2 kugeza kuri 6 mwatoranyije umukino wo guhuza. Amafoto aguma mu rubuga rwanyu ntaboherezwa cyangwa ngo abikwe.

items.q: Igikorwa kigomba kumara igihe kingana iki?
items.a: Akenshi iminota 10 kugeza kuri 20 irahagije, kandi rimwe na rimwe iminota 2 ni intsinzi. Witegereze ibimenyetso by'umunaniro cyangwa by'umujinya, maze uhagarike igihe bikiri byiza. Nta gihe cy'ukuri gihari.

items.q: Bigenda bite niba batifuza gukora igikorwa?
items.a: Yubahiriza 'oya' yabo, hanyuma ugerageze nyuma cyangwa mu buryo bundi. Kwanga bishobora guterwa n'umunaniro, ububabare, kutumva neza cyangwa kutagira icyo bashaka. Reba igitabo cyacu ku byo gukora igihe bavuze oya.

items.q: Ni ibihe bikorwa bikwiriye igihe cya dementia cyateye imbere?
items.a: Guhumuriza no kumva ibyiyumvo: kumva umuziki bakunda, gukanda ibiganza ukoresheje amavuta, kureba amafoto hamwe, gufata igitambaro cyoroshye, kwicara hanze, cyangwa umukino woroshye w'ishusho uri kumwe nabo. Igitabo cyacu cy'icyiciro cya nyuma gifite ibitekerezo byinshi.

items.q: Hari ibikorwa by'amatsinda mu kigo cyita ku bageze mu za bukuru?
items.a: Yego. Bingo y'amashusho ifite amakarita yo gucapa n'uwuhamagara kuri ecran, naho Uzuza imvugo n'Amakarita y'ibiganiro bikora neza iyo bisomwe mu ijwi riranguruye. Igitabo cyacu cy'amatsinda mu bigo byita ku bantu gisobanura umubare w'abantu, aho bicara no guhindura igikorwa ku bafite ubushobozi butandukanye.

items.q: Imikino ishobora kwirinda cyangwa gutinza dementia?
items.a: Nta mukino wigeze werekana ko wakwirinda dementia, kandi imikino yacu ntivuga ibyo. Gukangurira ubwonko mu buryo bw'imibanire byagaragaje inyungu nto mu bushakashatsi ku bantu bafite dementia yoroheje cyangwa iringaniye, ariko ibyo ni ibindi bitandukanye no kuvuga ko umukino wakwirinda indwara. Dutanga imikino yo kwishimana no kwishyira hamwe.

Ntibishoboka neza. Ubushakashatsi buhuza ibintu 14 by'ubuzima n'imibereho n'ibyago bya dementia, nko kutumva neza, umuvuduko w'amaraso mwinshi, kutagira imyitozo y'umubiri no kwigunga mu bantu. Kubikemura bishobora kugabanya ibyago ku bamwe, ariko abantu benshi bakora ibyiza byose bakarwara dementia. Nta muntu ugomba kubiryozwa.

items.q: Kwiyiriza ubusa by'igihe gito bifasha ubwonko?
items.a: Ibimenyetso ku bantu ni bike kandi bikiri bishya, naho ubushakashatsi benshi bwakorewe ku nyamaswa. Kwiyiriza ubusa bishobora guteza akaga ku bakuze, cyane cyane ku bafata imiti ya diyabete cyangwa ku bagabanuka ibiro batabishaka, kandi ntibisabwa ku bantu babana na dementia. Vugana na muganga mbere yo guhindura uko murya.

Nta konti cyangwa kwamamaza. Dukoresha Google Analytics kubara gusura no kumenya amapaji afasha, kandi urubuga rwanyu rwibuka niba mwafunguye amajwi yoroheje. Amafoto mwatoranyije ya Amafoto ahuje ntiboherezwa na rimwe. Reba Itangazo ry'ibanga kugira ngo mumenye byinshi.
Oya. Golden Moments ni iy'imyidagaduro no kumenyesha muri rusange. Ku bibazo by'ubuzima, vugana na muganga, naho mu gihe cy'ihutirwa hamagara 112.

faq.moreHtml: Ibindi bisobanuro: uko mwakinira hamwe, igihe bavuze oya, ibikorwa by'icyiciro cya nyuma na dementia ishobora kwirindwa?

handout.title: Imikino yoroheje kandi y'ubuntu ku bantu babana na dementia
handout.seoTitle: Urupapuro rwo gucapa: Imikino y'ubuntu ya dementia kuri interineti
handout.description: Urupapuro rumwe rwo gucapa ku miryango n'abita ku bantu, ku mikino y'amashusho yoroheje kandi y'ubuntu ku bantu babana na dementia, ku matsinda y'inkunga n'ibikapu by'ubufasha.
handout.lede: Capisha iyi paji ku itsinda ry'inkunga, ku gikapu cy'ubufasha cyangwa ku rugi rw'ifriji. Koresha Print ya browser yanyu; amamenu n'amabuto ntibizajya ku mpapuro.
handout.introHtml: Amashusho manini, amagambo yoroshye kandi nta kintu cyo gutsindwa. Ni ubuntu kuri telefoni, tabuleti cyangwa mudasobwa, nta konti, nta kwamamaza, nta bihe cyangwa amanota. Mwicarane iruhande rumwe kandi mufatanye ibihe byo gukina.
handout.restHtml:
Inama nke

  • Hitamo igihe cy'umunsi uwo muntu aba ameze neza.
  • Tangira n'igenamiterere ryoroshye. Amashusho ane arahagije.
  • Muvugane ku mashusho. Ikiganiro akenshi ni cyo gice cyiza.
  • Muhagarike igihe bikiri bishimishije. Guhagarika hakiri kare ni umusaruro mwiza.

Ibindi biri ku rubuga

  • Ibyo gucapa by'ubuntu: ishakisha ry'amagambo y'inyuguti nini, amapaji yo gushushanya, amakarita y'ibiganiro na bingo y'amashusho.
  • Ibitekerezo by'ibikorwa ku cyiciro cyose, n'ibitabo ku gukinira hamwe no kwita ku buzima bwanyu.

Ni ukwishimana no kumarana igihe. Ntabwo ari inama z'ubuvuzi, ikizamini cyangwa ubuvuzi. Golden Moments itangazwa na Cloudjet Solutions Pte. Ltd.

organizations.title: Ku bigo byita ku bageze mu za bukuru, amasomero n'amatsinda y'inkunga
organizations.seoTitle: Imyidagaduro y'ubuntu ku bantu babana n'indwara yo kwibagirwa igenewe ibigo n'amatsinda
organizations.description: Uburyo ibigo byita ku bageze mu za bukuru, gahunda z'amanywa, amasomero, ibigo bishinzwe abageze mu za bukuru n'amatsinda yo gufashanya bakoresha imikino yacu y'ubuntu igenewe abantu babana n'indwara yo kwibagirwa, hamwe n'amagambo yo kudushyira ku rutonde rw'ibikoresho bifasha.
organizations.lede: Ibiri kuri uru rubuga byose ni ubuntu kubikoresha hamwe n'ababa mu bigo, abanyamuryango n'abandi bantu mwitaho, nta konti, uruhushya cyangwa ikiguzi bisabwa. Uru rupapuro rusobanura ibiri hano n'uburyo bwo kubisangiza abandi.
organizations.shortText: {name}: imikino yoroheje ifite amashusho n'ibitabo biyobora imyidagaduro by'ubuntu ku bantu babana n'indwara yo kwibagirwa n'ababitaho. Nta kwiyandikisha, nta kubara igihe, nta n'amanota.
organizations.longText: {name} ({domain}) itanga imikino {count} yo kuri murandasi y'ubuntu yakorewe abantu babana n'indwara yo kwibagirwa, harimo guhuza amashusho asa aguma agaragara, puzzle yoroheje, gushyira ibintu mu byiciro, imvugo zizwi, na bingo y'amashusho ifite amakarita ashobora gucapwa. Nta konti, nta matangazo, nta kubara igihe cyangwa amanota. Uru rubuga rufite kandi amabwiriza y'imyidagaduro yanditse mu rurimi rworoshye ku byiciro byose by'indwara yo kwibagirwa, ashingiye ku bushakashatsi bwa National Institute on Aging na Alzheimer's Association.
organizations.gamesItemHtml: Imikino {count} yo kuri murandasi ikorera kuri mudasobwa igendanwa, tabuleti cyangwa televiziyo ifatanye na mudasobwa. Nta gushyiramo porogaramu, nta konti, nta no gukurura kuri interineti. Reba imikino yose.
organizations.printablesAfter: Koresha akabuto ko gucapa kuri buri rupapuro.
organizations.moreItemsHtml:
• Uburyo bw'amatsinda: Bingo y'amashusho ifite amakarita ashobora gucapwa n'amashusho agaragara kuri mudasobwa ahamagara, kandi ibibazo byoroheje bifite ibibazo 50 birimo amahitamo y'ibisubizo n'ingingo zo kuganiraho.
  • Ibitabo biyobora imyidagaduro byagenewe abakozi n'imiryango, bikurikije icyiciro n'ubwoko, byanditse mu magambo asanzwe kandi bigaragaza inkomoko. Tangirira ku bitekerezo 101 by'imyidagaduro cyangwa imyidagaduro y'amatsinda mu bigo byita ku bageze mu za bukuru.
organizations.restHtml:
Uburyo amatsinda abikoresha

  • Ibigo byita ku bageze mu za bukuru no kwibuka: bingo y'amashusho cyangwa kuzuza imvugo kuri televiziyo yo mu cyumba rusange, umuntu umwe agakanda ku bikoresho afasha itsinda ryose.
  • Gahunda z'amanywa z'abakuze: ahantu hari tabuleti irimo imikino yo guhuza amashusho igizwe n'uduce tune gusa, igenewe ibihe bigufi hagati y'umuntu umwe n'umwita ho.
  • Amasomero rusange: gushakisha amagambo kwacapwe n'amakarita y'ibiganiro mu bikoresho byo kwibuka, hamwe no kubika uru rubuga kuri tabuleti zo mu isomero.
  • Amatsinda yo gufasha abitaho abandi n'ahantu ho guhurira: urupapuro rumwe rucapwa rurimo amakuru agenewe imiryango ngo bajyane mu rugo.
  • Ibitaro n'abategura gusezerera abari mu bitaro: urupapuro mu bikoresho bihabwa abitaho abandi, kugira ngo babone igikorwa gituje cyo gukorera mu rugo cyangwa iruhande rw'igitanda.

Ibyo tudakora

Iyi mikino igenewe kwidagadura no kumara igihe hamwe. Ntabwo isuzuma, ntipima, ntiyerekana amanota, ntikiza cyangwa ngo igabanye umuvuduko w'indwara yo kwibagirwa, kandi dusaba ibigo kutayisobanura muri ubwo buryo. Nta matangazo arimo, kandi imikino ntiyaka amazina, amakuru y'ubuzima cyangwa ngo isabe gushyiraho amafoto. Uru rubuga rukoresha Google Analytics kugira ngo rubare abasura; amabwiriza yacu yerekeye ubuzima bwite asobanura ibyo ikusanya. Amafoto akoreshwa muri Guhuza amafoto aguma muri mudasobwa cyangwa telefoni ukoresha.

Dushyire ku rutonde rw'ibikoresho byanyu bifasha

Niba ufite urutonde rw'ibikoresho bifasha abitaho abandi, uhawe ikaze gushyiraho umurongowerekeza kuri {domain}. Ushobora gukoporora ibisobanuro bigufi cyangwa ibirambuye.
organizations.linksHtml:
Impapuro z'ingirakamaro ushobora gushyiraho imirongo yerekezaho: imikino y'ubuntu, inyandiko zicapwa z'ubuntu, imyidagaduro ku bantu bafite Alzheimer na uburyo bwo gukinira hamwe.

Ibibazo cyangwa gukosora

Niba hari ikintu kitari cyo cyangwa kidasobanutse kuri uru rubuga, cyangwa se ibiri hano bikaba bidahuye n'ibyo umuntu mwitaho akeneye, tubwire kuri {email}. Nyamuneka ntimukohereze amakuru bwite cyangwa ay'ubuzima bw'abo mwitaho.

app.title: Porogaramu ya Golden Moments
app.seoTitle: Porogaramu ya Golden Moments ya iPhone na Android
app.description: Porogaramu y'ubuntu ya Golden Moments: guhuza amafoto mu buryo bworoshye ukoresheje uduce tune tunini, amafoto y'umuryango aguma ku gikoresho cyawe, amatsinda y'amashusho akora nta interineti, kandi nta konti isabwa.
app.lede: Ibyo wakunze byose kuri uru rubuga, muri porogaramu ikora nta interineti kandi ishobora gukoresha amafoto y'umuryango wihitiyemo.
app.bodyHtml:
Tangirira ku bito

Tangirira ku dukarita tune tunini n'amafoto asanzwe amenyerewe. Amafoto yaguma agaragara, cyangwa mukayahisha igihe mubona bibabereye byiza. Uburyo butuje butarimo kubara igihe, amanota cyangwa ibihano. Hitamo udukarita 4, 6, 8 cyangwa 12.

Bikore mu buryo bwite

Hitamo amafoto y'umuryango ukoresheje ahabugenewe ku gikoresho cyawe. Porogaramu ibika kopi nto zo gukoresha muri iyi mikino. Ntabwo isoma ahandi hose mu mafoto yawe cyangwa ngo ihindure amafoto yawe y'umwimerere, kandi ibika amafoto agera kuri 24 mu cyiciro kimwe.

Kurebera hamwe gusa

Murebe ifoto imwe icyarimwe. Hari ibibazo byoroheje bishobora gufasha gutangiza ikiganiro, bitiriwe bisaba umuntu kwibuka amazina cyangwa gutanga igisubizo cy'ukuri. Kureba gusa birahagije.

Ikora no mu gihe udafite interineti

Amafoto yo gutangiriraho n'ibice byose uko ari umunani by'amafoto bibarizwa muri porogaramu. Kopi z'amafoto zinjijwemo zikora nta nterineti. Guhitamo amafoto y'umwimerere abitswe muri iCloud gusa bishobora gukenera interineti.

Nta konti ikenewe, nta seriveri ibika amafoto

Kopi z'amafoto y'umuryango ziguma muri porogaramu ku gikoresho cyawe. Urashobora gukuramo izo kopi utangiritse amafoto yawe y'umwimerere. Kopi y'ububiko bw'igikoresho cyawe ishobora kubika amakuru ya porogaramu. Soma amategeko agenga ubuzima bwite ya porogaramu, kandi ubufasha bwa porogaramu busobanura buri ntambwe.
app.disclaimer: Golden Moments igamije kwidagadura no gusangira ikiganiro. Ntabwo isuzuma, ivura, irinda cyangwa ipima uburwayi bwo kwibagirwa (dementia) cyangwa indwara ya Alzheimer.

gamesIndex.title: Imikino yo kuri Interineti y'Ubuntu ku Bantu Babana no Kwibagirwa na Alzheimer
gamesIndex.description: Imikino y'ubuntu yo kuri interineti igenewe abakuze babana no kwibagirwa cyangwa Alzheimer: guhuza amafoto, guteranya amashusho byoroshye, gutoranya, imigani n'imvugo, gusiga amabara, na bingo. Nta kwiyandikisha, nta kubara igihe cyangwa amanota.
gamesIndex.h1: Imikino Ituje ku Bantu Babana no Kwibagirwa
gamesIndex.lede: Imikino {count} y'ubuntu mukinira hamwe muri mushakisha yanyu. Amafoto manini, amagambo yoroheje, kandi nta gutsindwa: nta kubara igihe, nta manota, nta no kwiyandikisha.
gamesIndex.listName: Imikino ituje ku bantu babana no kwibagirwa
gamesIndex.byStageLede: Ibiciro bitangwa nk'ubuyobozi rusange gusa. Kurikiza icyo uwo mwitaho yishimira n'icyo yumva kimubereye neza uyu munsi.
gamesIndex.moreHtml: Ibindi bitekerezo bitari ibyo kuri mudasobwa: ibikorwa 101 ku bantu babana no kwibagirwa, ibikorwa n'imikino ku barwaye Alzheimer, imikino ituje y'ubwenge hamwe na puzile.

faq.a: Guhuza amafoto abiri abiri ku dukarita tune ni amahitamo meza kandi atuje yo gutangiriraho. Niba guhitamo hagati y'amafoto bisa nk'ibigoranye, gerageza Gushaka asa ukoresheje amafoto abiri. Ku itsinda ry'abantu, gerageza Bingo y'amafoto.

faq.q: Ese iyi mikino ikora kuri iPad cyangwa telefoni?
faq.a: Yego. Buri mukino ukora muri mushakisha kuri telefoni, mudasobwa zikoze nk'ibirahure (tableti) na mudasobwa zisanzwe, kandi amafoto yaguka akwirwa kuri ecran. Tableti iteretse ku cyo kuyifata ikunze kubera neza abantu babiri.

faq.q: Ese iyi mikino ibereye umuntu ubana na Alzheimer?
faq.a: Yego. Yateguriwe abantu babana n'uburwayi bwo kwibagirwa, harimo na Alzheimer ari na yo ikunze kubitera cyane. Amafoto aguma agaragara, amahitamo ni make, kandi nta kubara igihe cyangwa amanota, bityo imikino yibanda ku kumenya ibintu bimenyerewe aho kwibuka ibishya.

faq.q: Ese iyi ni imikino yo kwibuka igenewe abageze mu zabukuru?
faq.a: Ni imikino yo guhuza no kureba amafoto buri muntu wese ugeze mu zabukuru yakwishimira, ariko yakozwe ku buryo idasuzuma ubushobozi bwo kwibuka: muri Guhuza amafoto, amafoto aguma agaragara keretse wowe ubwawe uhisemo kuyahisha. Ubuyobozi bwacu ku mikino yo kwibuka ku bageze mu zabukuru babana no kwibagirwa busobanura uburyo umukino uwo ari wo wose wakorwa mu buryo butuje.

faq.q: Ese hari imikino igenewe amatsinda mu bigo byita ku bageze mu zabukuru?
faq.a: Yego. Bingo y'amafoto ifite amakarita ashobora gucapwa n'uyobora umukino ugaragara kuri ecran, kandi Kurangiza umugani hamwe n'Amakarita yo gutangiza ikiganiro birakora neza iyo bisomewe itsinda mu ijwi riranguruye.

faq.q: Ese hari porogaramu y'imikino n'ibikorwa ku bantu babana no kwibagirwa?
faq.a: Yego. Golden Moments (yanditse nka "{storeName}") iboneka ku buntu kuri App Store na Google Play. Itanga imikino ituje yo guhuza amafoto ku dukarita tunini, imikino ikoresha amafoto y'umuryango wihitiyemo, n'ibice by'amafoto bikora nta nterineti.

faq.q: Ese porogaramu ya Golden Moments ni ubuntu?
faq.a: Yego. Kuyimanura ni ubuntu, nta matangazo, nta konti cyangwa kugira ibyo ugura muri yo.

faq.q: Ese iyi porogaramu ikora nta nterineti?
faq.a: Yego. Amafoto yo gutangiriraho n'ibice byose uko ari umunani by'amafoto bibarizwa muri porogaramu, kandi amafoto y'umuryango akora nta nterineti iyo amaze gukopororwa muri porogaramu. Guhitamo ifoto ibitswe muri iCloud gusa bishobora gukenera interineti.

faq.q: Ese nshobora gukoresha amafoto yacu bwite y'umuryango?
faq.a: Yego. Hitamo amafoto ukoresheje icyuma gihitamo amafoto cy’igikoresho cyawe. Porogaramu ibika kopi nto z’ayo mafoto ku gikoresho kugira ngo ikoreshe mu mikino yayo, ntiyohereza ayo mafoto ahandi kandi ntihindura amafoto y’umwimerere. Ushobora gukuraho izo kopi igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.

faq.q: Ese ni porogaramu yo gukora imyitozo y’ubwonko cyangwa igerageza ry’ubwibuke?
faq.a: Oya. Golden Moments igenewe kwishimisha no kumarana igihe. Nta manota cyangwa ibizamini irimo, kandi ntisuzuma, ntivura, ntirinda cyangwa ngo ipime indwara yo kwibagirwa cyangwa indwara ya Alzheimer.

gameFaqYes.q: Hari verisiyo ya porogaramu y’uyu mukino?
gameFaqYes.a: Yego. Porogaramu ya Golden Moments yo ku buntu, ikora ku iPhone, iPad na Android, irimo umukino woroheje wo guhuza amafoto, ishobora gukoresha amafoto y’umuryango wawe uhitamo, kandi ikora idafite interineti. Nta konti, nta matangazo kandi nta manota.

gameFaqNo.q: Hari verisiyo ya porogaramu y’uyu mukino?
gameFaqNo.a: Ntabwo ari verisiyo y’uyu mukino. Porogaramu ya Golden Moments yo ku buntu, ikora ku iPhone, iPad na Android, irimo umukino woroheje wo guhuza amafoto ufite amashusho manini n’amafoto y’umuryango uhitamo, kandi ikora idafite interineti. Uyu mukino uguma ari ubuntu hano, mu mushakisha wawe.
